ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle BCD, with B at the lower left, D at the lower right, and C above. Next to the left slanted side BC is labeled 2x+4, next to the right slanted side CD is labeled 10, and next to the base BD is labeled x+2. There is an identical pink tick mark on each of BC and CD, indicating that the lengths of these two sides are equal. Reasoning: Because BC and CD have identical tick marks, BC = CD. From the labels in the figure, 2x+4 = 10. Solving gives 2x = 6, so x = 3. BC is required, and BC = 2x+4 = 2(3)+4 = 10.
